Definition: Identifier for one employee-to-project weekly assignment
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Unique and nonblank; multiple assignments for an employee/week are legitimate

Definition: Employee assigned to the project
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Must exist in Employees and have a matching Capacity employee/week record

Definition: Project receiving the assigned work
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Must exist in Projects; task-level mapping is unavailable

Definition: Monday starting the planned assignment week
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Monday from 2026-11-23 through 2027-02-08; match periods before comparing demand and capacity

Definition: Hours of work assigned to the employee/project/week
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Nonnegative; add assignments to measure demand; exceeding capacity is a planning issue, not necessarily a data error

Definition: Employee whose availability is recorded
Key_or_reference: Part of composite key; references Employees.EmployeeID
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Must exist in Employees; unique together with WeekStart

Definition: Monday starting the availability week
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Monday from 2026-11-23 through 2027-02-08; match periods before comparing demand and capacity

Definition: Net hours available to the employee in this week
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Nonnegative net weekly availability; zero can be valid; investigate implausibly large amounts; do not duplicate across assignments

Definition: Identifier of one ledger event
Key_or_reference: Intended transaction primary key; raw duplicates/conflicts may occur
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Unique after resolving duplicates; do not drop conflicting amounts without review

Definition: Task to which the cumulative cost belongs
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Must exist in Tasks

Definition: Date of the individual transaction
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Valid date through 2026-11-22; credit date should not precede referenced charge

Definition: Cost classification; raw values include label variations
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Canonical Labour, Materials, Equipment, Subcontractor; normalise labels with documented mappings

Definition: Signed amount of this individual transaction, not a cumulative balance
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Positive Charge or negative Credit; reconcile EntryType and ReversalOfCostID; missing amount is not zero

Definition: Identifies charge or credit adjustment
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data
Validation_rule: Charge or Credit; reconcile sign

Definition: Original charge adjusted by this credit; partial credits permitted
Null_rule: Blank for Charge; required for Credit
Validation_rule: Must resolve to original Charge for a Credit; validate same task/category and date order

Definition: Anonymised identifier for one fictional staff member
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Unique and nonblank; does not identify a real person

Definition: Single role assigned to this employee for the capacity window
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Civil Engineer, MEP Engineer, Technician, Supervisor, Planner or Quantity Surveyor; missing and variant labels may occur

Definition: Employee base location, not proof of assignment feasibility
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data
Validation_rule: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah

Definition: Stable identifier for one fictional project
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Unique and nonblank; preserve as text

Definition: Display name of the fictional construction project
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Nonblank; do not use display name as join key

Definition: Location assigned to the project
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah; source may contain spelling/case/abbreviation variants

Definition: Currency code for all project monetary amounts
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: AED in this supplied scenario; do not combine currencies without conversion

Definition: Type of construction project
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data
Validation_rule: Residential, Commercial, Warehouse, Healthcare, Education

Definition: Stable identifier for one task
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Unique and nonblank

Definition: Project to which the task belongs
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Must exist in Projects

Definition: Construction activity stage assigned to the task
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Design, Approvals, Procurement, Structure, Fit-out or Handover; stage order is not a dependency network

Definition: Baseline planned first calendar day of task
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Valid date; no later than PlannedEnd

Definition: Baseline planned final calendar day of task
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Valid date; no earlier than PlannedStart

Definition: Recorded finish date for a completed task
Null_rule: Yes, if Completion < 1
Validation_rule: Blank for unfinished task; required for completed task; no later than SnapshotDate; investigate inconsistent dates

Definition: Proportion of task work completed at the cutoff
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Between 0 and 1 inclusive; 1 means complete; do not confuse 0.5 with 0.5 percent

Definition: Full baseline budget allocated to this task
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data; raw defects may occur
Validation_rule: Greater than zero in this scenario; counted once per task; no category budget is supplied

Definition: Date to which task completion applies
Null_rule: Not allowed in clean data
Validation_rule: Fixed as 2026-11-22
